name: Ask
description: Put a clip to a model running on your machine through Ollama: summarize, fix, explain, or ask your own question
author: georgemandis

prompt.hint:
Type ? and a question in the search field, then press ↩.

?what is the deadline
?reply politely, declining
?turn this into a table

The answer appears here. Press ↩ again to use it.

model.label: Model
model.description: Automatic uses the most recently installed general model between 2 and 12 GB. A name picks the newest installed model that starts with it. Models that Ollama runs on its cloud are never used.
